svg.title: Pocket Invoice journey in high fidelity: every phone screen on one canvas, connected by its 19 transitions
svg.desc: The 11 high-fidelity phone screens, placed as on the low-fidelity journey. Each line starts at the control that causes it, or at the side of the screen when no control does, and carries the same number as on the sitemap.

path.title: 1. signup to invoices-empty: Create workspace with a valid email address and a workspace name
2. signup to signup-error: Create workspace with a badly formed email address or no workspace name
3. signup-error to invoices-empty: Fix both fields and create the workspace
4. signup to sign-in: Choose I already have an account
5. sign-in to signup: Back to create a workspace
6. invoices-empty to invoice-new: Create your first invoice
7. invoice-new to invoice-review: Check invoice with every field valid
8. invoice-new to invoice-new-error: Check invoice with no client name or an amount of 0 or less
9. invoice-new-error to invoice-review: Fix the fields and check the invoice
12. discard-dialog to invoice-new: Keep editing, or press Escape
14. invoice-review to invoice-new: Change details: every value is kept
16. invoice-review to send-error: Send invoice to an address that cannot receive mail (in the example, any address ending in .invalid)
17. send-error to invoice-new: Change the email address
18. invoice-sent to invoices-list: Back to invoices

svg.text: The screens are the files in screens/phone/ at half size. Lines that start at the side of a screen have no button: see the prototype-only links.
